# Suzanne Scott Skin Care

> Suzanne Scott Skin Care is a skincare practice offering holistic facials and lash and brow services in San Francisco and Marin, California. Esthetician Suzanne Scott has practiced for over 30 years. Her facials pair classic European techniques with connective tissue release and manual lymphatic drainage. Appointments run Monday, Wednesday and Saturday in San Francisco, and Thursday in San Rafael.

Website: https://suzannescottskincare.com/
Last updated: 2026-09-30

## Services
- Custom Holistic Facial: 60 minutes $165; 90 minutes $225. Each session begins with careful cleansing and gentle exfoliation, with extractions when needed. Massage therapies, including connective tissue release and manual lymphatic drainage, help the skin lift, sculpt and glow.
- Brow wax or tweeze: 30 minutes, $40
- Brow tint: 30 minutes, $30
- Lash tint: 30 minutes, $35
- Lash and brow tint: $60

## Locations
- San Francisco (Monday, Wednesday and Saturday): 166 Geary Street, Suite 1006, San Francisco, CA 94108, at Yelena's Spa
- Marin (Thursday): 30 H Street, San Rafael, CA 94901, at Lise of Copenhagen

## About
- Suzanne Scott is an esthetician with over 30 years of practice.
- Her treatments are restorative and combine classic European techniques with intuitive, holistic rituals.
- Every facial is custom. She uses connective tissue release and manual lymphatic drainage to help the skin lift and sculpt, soothe the nervous system and restore balance.

## Contact and booking
- Email: suzannelscott@yahoo.com
- Phone: (415) 497-3983
- To book, email or call and name the location (San Francisco or Marin).

## Policies
- Cancellations and reschedules need at least 24 hours' notice. Cancellations made with less than 24 hours' notice are charged 50% of the total service cost.

## Quick answers
- Who is Suzanne Scott? An esthetician with over 30 years of practice who runs Suzanne Scott Skin Care in San Francisco and Marin.
- How much is a facial with Suzanne Scott? The Custom Holistic Facial is $165 for 60 minutes or $225 for 90 minutes.
- What makes the facial holistic? It pairs classic European techniques with connective tissue release and manual lymphatic drainage, aimed at lifting and sculpting the skin while soothing the nervous system.
- Where is Suzanne Scott Skin Care? At Yelena's Spa, 166 Geary Street, Suite 1006, San Francisco (Monday, Wednesday, Saturday), and at Lise of Copenhagen, 30 H Street, San Rafael (Thursday).
- Does Suzanne Scott offer lash and brow services? Yes: brow wax or tweeze ($40), brow tint ($30), lash tint ($35), and lash and brow tint ($60).
